Topics · Meaning and purpose

What was I made for?

The text's short answer: worship in its wide sense, care of the earth, and return. The choice stays yours.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

Quran · Adh-Dhariyat 51:56

Translation

This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

Original · Hebrew

ס֥וֹף דָּבָ֖ר הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־זֶ֖ה כָּל־הָאָדָֽם׃

Ecclesiastes · 12:13

World English Bible

The question assumes you were made, which you may not grant. So read it as: if something made you on purpose, what would the purpose be? The answer here is one word, and it is often heard narrowly. Worship here need not mean only ritual. Many readers take it as a whole life turned toward what is true and good: honest work, keeping a promise, being fair, standing in awe. On that reading the purpose is not to fill time. It is to live toward the source of your life.

A question for you

How do you hear the word 'worship'?

If you sayRituals imposed on me.
ThenMany heard it so. Why a perfect being would want it has its own page.
If you sayThe direction of a whole life.
ThenThat is the wide sense, and what follows shows its shape.
If you sayI don't know what it means.
ThenThat is fine. Stay with the question: what is your life turned toward now?

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority."[17] They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?"[18] He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

Translator's notes

[17] Khalīfah: successor, or generations of man, one following another. [18] An additional meaning is "...and we purify ourselves for You."

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:30

Translation

One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

Original · Hebrew

Isaiah · 6:3

World English Bible

﴿وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And to Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

Quran · Hud 11:61

Translation

For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

Original · Hebrew

כִּי־ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

the Psalms · 103:14

World English Bible

The next part of the answer is about this earth. A human being is described as a successor here: someone entrusted, who stands in for another, and is answerable. And people are said to have been raised up from the earth and given it to build. So the purpose is not only inward. It includes tending what is here: being fair, feeding the hungry, repairing what is broken, leaving a place better. Whatever you believe about the rest, that is work your hands can do today.

A question for you

What is your place in the world most like?

If you sayA guest.
ThenA guest treats the house well and leaves. That is close to the picture of a trust.
If you sayAn owner.
ThenPerhaps. The question is what becomes of your ownership when you leave.
If you sayNothing. I am an accident.
ThenThat is a serious position. It is still in your hands to treat what is around you well.

Part 3 of 3

﴿قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:162

Translation

Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you. My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

Original · Hebrew

מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃ אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־עָלֶֽיךָ׃

the Psalms · 16:1-2

World English Bible

The last part gathers the others. This sentence is a statement of a whole life: my prayer, my devotion, my living and my dying belong to the Lord of all worlds. Notice it doesn't say my prayer only. Living is in the list, and so is dying. Read as an argument, it says a life can be one thing, with no gap between what is holy and what is ordinary. You are not asked to say this. You are asked what your life is one thing about, if anything.

A question for you

What is your life gathered around now?
